subject: Post-call recap + legal queue follow-up for CloudPay SOW
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@cloudpay.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T15:20:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — CloudPay integration

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — good conversation. Quick recap and the next few asks so we keep momentum: 

Summary (from our discovery)
- Primary use case: payment reconciliation + multi-tenant embeddings for chargeback resolution
- Expected Q3 pilot: ~2M tokens/month, latency SLOs ~300ms p50 for lookups
- Data security: customer PII stays on-prem or in VPC; audit logs required

Next steps (agreed on call)
1) I shared an initial SOW (attached) with commercial terms for the pilot. Please route to your procurement/legal for redlines.
2) If legal is OK, procurement will confirm PO timing — you mentioned an internal procurement window at the end of July.
3) We'll stand up a sandbox environment once PO is in place; I'll coordinate with Diego on environment details.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.docx (docx)

Can you confirm who on your side will be the procurement contact and the expected review timeline? If it helps, we can hop on a 20-minute session for the legal team to run through the data and security controls (I’ll bring Jasmine).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform for LLMs

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the summary and the SOW — I routed this to our procurement and legal (cc'd Ben). Procurement is stretched this week but they acknowledged receipt and Ben said he’ll take a first pass on the redlines.

Procurement contact: Maya Lopez (procurement@cloudpay.com) — she’ll own PO timing.
Estimated review: Ben said he should have initial redlines by early next week but asked for any clarifications in the meantime.

Appreciate it,
Samira

From: Ben Hargreaves <ben.h@cloudpay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira@cloudpay.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:33:00Z
Subject: CloudPay — redlined SOW and a couple of questions

Priya — attaching our redlined version. Main asks: 
- Narrow the indemnity carve-out for data processed during the pilot (we proposed a mutual indemnity cap tied to fees).
- Add a 30-day retention window option for logs (we prefer a short retention unless otherwise required).

See attachment: CloudPay_SOW_redline_v2.pdf (pdf) — includes inline comments at sections 2.3 and 5.1.

We’re generally happy with the approach; procurement will align on the PO once legal is stable here.

If Redwood wants to preserve any specific language (esp around audit access), flag it and we can try to work it through.

Ben Hargreaves
Senior Counsel, CloudPay
ben.h@cloudpay.com

Subject: Checking in on the SOW redlines / procurement timing

Hi Samira & Ben — quick ping since I haven’t heard back after the redlines on 7/12. Wanted to check where this sits with counsel and procurement and whether anything from our side would speed things up.

Short options from our side to unblock:
- Option A: Jasmine (security) and I do a 20-min walkthrough with Ben to go through the comments in CloudPay_SOW_redline_v2.pdf — available Tue/Wed next week.
- Option B: We accept the proposed 30-day log retention for the pilot and add a short audit window language that preserves necessary traceability; we can formalize via a one-paragraph amendment so procurement can move to PO.

If procurement timing has shifted and the pilot is no longer a near-term priority, can you let me know so we can adjust internal plans accordingly? We’re happy to be flexible but want to avoid blocking Diego’s environment schedule.

Attachments referenced: CloudPay_SOW_redline_v2.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — happy to take a quick call today if that helps.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
